workflow_instructions.mode_overview: TypeScript Code Quality mode ensures code follows DRY, SOLID, LEAN, and KISS principles. Focuses on refactoring existing code, writing clean TypeScript modules, and reviewing code quality.

step.details: Identify whether the user wants to: - Refactor existing code - Write new TypeScript code - Review code for quality issues - Apply specific principles (DRY, SOLID, LEAN, KISS)

Review the minimal set of repository materials: - Target TypeScript files to refactor or extend - Related modules and dependencies - Existing patterns in the codebase - package.json and tsconfig.json for context

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze current code for principle violations

completion_criteria.criterion: Code follows DRY, SOLID, LEAN, KISS principles

boundaries.rule: Only edit TypeScript files in clients/cliff-watch-witness/
Never modify system files or require system-level installation
Hand off to Architecture Refactor mode for architectural decisions
